# JARVO

> JARVO is a self-hosted AI team ("your digital right hand") that turns an idea into a finished result: research, websites, videos, paid ads and documents.

JARVO runs on your own computer or server (Docker). A lead agent plans the work and hands it to specialists: a research detective, a web developer, a marketing and creative studio, a videographer, an ads specialist and a generalist right hand. Every result is reviewed against a definition of done before it reaches you.

## Main pages
- [Home](https://jarvo.pl/): what JARVO is and how to install it (one command for macOS, Linux and Windows)
